# @loom/dispatcher

Execution dispatcher for Loom — decides WHERE an execution runs and owns worker allocation, retries, timeout and result collection, sitting between the orchestrator and a WorkerRuntime

## Entry points

- `@loom/dispatcher`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
